styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a narrow one-tile-wide warmer case with shelves of buns. The measured facts support the references' level: 15 visible tones per tile against 9 for the hedge, 17 for the cheese stall and 20 for the well, 0% near-flat coverage, and 0% neutral dark edge pixels. That means the outline is tinted, a dark brown/orange-leaning tone, and not a uniform black sticker line.
